title: Context-intelligence Unit A2: incremental change classification, invalidation closure, incremental/full byte-identical parity (D-013)
objective: Implement D-013 Unit A2 on top of accepted A1: exact change-set derivation (added/content-modified/metadata-modified/deleted/renamed + parser/config/schema invalidations + deterministically affected importers), smallest proven invalidation closure, rename rebinding, full-rebuild-on-global-invalidator with reported reason, corruption/stale-lock/concurrent-writer detection with tested fail-closed rules, idempotent retries, and the enforced BYTE-IDENTICAL incremental-vs-clean-full parity invariant (owner decision 6) with the benchmark scenario matrix (no-change/one-file/dependency/delete/rename/parser-version/config/corrupt-cache/interrupted-write/concurrent-writer, cold+warm). Implemented as: the snapshot fingerprint always hashes content (mtime never trusted); an unchanged snapshot reuses the validated cached generation (the win = skipping parse/resolve); a changed snapshot derives the exact change set + affected importer closure and rebuilds via the same full builder so parity holds by construction; a global invalidator forces a full rebuild with a recorded reason. The byte-identical incremental-vs-clean-full parity invariant is enforced by test (D-013-R037/R079).
business_reason: D-013 Unit A2; only after A1 is reviewed and accepted (owner decision 4).

acceptance_scenarios.given: a cached generation for the current snapshot
acceptance_scenarios.when: an incremental build runs on the unchanged snapshot
acceptance_scenarios.then: the validated generation is reused (cache hit, no reparse) and its export is byte-identical to a clean full rebuild

acceptance_scenarios.given: content/add/delete/rename/metadata changes and a global (parser/config/schema/eligibility) invalidator
acceptance_scenarios.then: each is classified exactly (added/content_modified/metadata_modified/deleted/renamed/global_invalidators); a rename is not double-counted as add+delete

only changed eligible files drive the decision, the deterministically affected importer closure is computed, a full rebuild runs with a recorded reason, and the export is BYTE-IDENTICAL to a clean full rebuild

acceptance_scenarios.given: a corrupt/incomplete generation, a stale lock, or a concurrent writer
acceptance_scenarios.then: the fail-closed A1 cache rules apply (quarantine + rebuild), retries are idempotent, and no half-index is served

acceptance_scenarios.when: incremental output is compared against a clean full rebuild across every change class
